_README: #850 E2 arm 2 — 'a declared element no validator token speaks about'. THE RATCHET BASELINE.
Per stage, carrying the ELEMENT NAMES: this file IS the audit object, not a bare count, so a plateau
is legible per stage and a reader can see WHICH elements no validator polices.
CI fails on any PER-STAGE INCREASE (driver/test/contract-audit.test.mjs) — a new unpoliced element in
one stage cannot hide behind a fix in another. A DECREASE is the point: regenerate this file when a
move lands. Wave 1's moves are EXPECTED to move these numbers; a wave that ends with them unmoved is
a finding for the handover, not a footnote.
Element names are the key, so RENAMING an element reads as +1 in its stage and fails. That is correct:
the baseline tracks named elements, and a rename is a new name. Regenerate rather than work around it.
